question: Which superhero has the same eyes, hair and skin colour? Indicate the publisher of the superhero.
evidence: which superhero refers to superhero_name; the same eyes, hair and skin colour refers to hair_colour_id = skin_colour_id AND hair_colour_id = eye_colour_id; publisher refers to publisher_name;
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching publisher record.
gold: SELECT T1.superhero_name, T2.publisher_name FROM superhero AS T1 LEFT JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id WHERE T1.eye_colour_id = T1.hair_colour_id AND T1.eye_colour_id = T1.skin_colour_id
gold0: SELECT T1.superhero_name, T2.publisher_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id WHERE T1.eye_colour_id = T1.hair_colour_id AND T1.eye_colour_id = T1.skin_colour_id

b.request: List the names of superheroes whose eye, hair, and skin colour IDs are all equal, along with each superhero’s publisher name, retaining superheroes with no matching publisher record
b.sql: SELECT s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name FROM superhero AS s LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE s.eye_colour_id = s.hair_colour_id AND s.hair_colour_id = s.skin_colour_id

d.request: Which superheroes have the same eye, hair, and skin colour? Show their publishers, including superheroes with no matching publisher record.
d.sql: SELECT s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name FROM superhero AS s LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id WHERE s.eye_colour_id = s.hair_colour_id AND s.hair_colour_id = s.skin_colour_id;
